title: Chutia Buranji
author: Dr. Swarnalata Barua & Dr. Dambarudhar Nath
genre: Critical Historical Chronicle of Upper Assam & Sadiya Frontier
description: Monumental critical edition of the Chutia Buranji published by the Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS), Narayani Handiqui Historical Institute, Guwahati, documenting the early kingdom of Sadiya, the interactions, royal matrimonial ties, and military encounters with the Tai-Ahoms, and the geopolitical integration of Upper Assam.
